title: MR- Dirección · How to run a scene
description: A three-minute walk through the direction bar and the editor.

steps.title: Your directing desk
steps.content: This bar helps you run the game live: read the scene, show it to the players, change the music without gaps, fire effects and place characters on the floor of the background. It works with any system. Use the buttons below to go forward and back.

steps.title: The bar
steps.content: It is GM-only. Drag it with the right mouse button and it remembers its place; menus close when you click outside. The chevron on the right folds it.

steps.title: Choose a scene
steps.content: Your configured scenes live here. Rest the cursor on one for one second to see its thumbnail before switching.

steps.title: Read and show
steps.content: Read scene opens your opening text with clickable cues. Show to everyone activates the scene for the players and starts its music.

steps.title: Music and motifs
steps.content: Change tracks with a gapless crossfade. Motifs (battle, tension, chase…) are tracks for a moment; press the active one again to return to the scene music. Reading mode lowers the background while you read.

steps.title: Mix, ambience and more
steps.content: Volume, scene ambience (light, dim, dark: lighting and volume change together), markers and the editor.

steps.title: The editor
steps.content: In the Editor you set up each scene without touching files: drag music, actors and journals from the sidebar, mark the floor and horizon for perspective, or press Auto-configure for a first draft. Install example gives you a small adventure to try.

steps.title: Go direct
steps.content: You can export your setup as a JSON pack and share it, or ship it with your adventure through the registerPack API. Replay this tour any time from Settings → Tours.
